entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

Yeah, listen, I bought a helmet from you people two months ago and I want to return it. Don't give me any runaround, I want my money back, and if I don't get it, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet.
I understand your frustration, and I'll do my best to help you with this. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson. Order number is VF77819. And it's for the Trail Helmet. The box is unopened, I haven't even looked at it since it arrived.

Thank you, Mark. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet here. So I can understand the situation correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

There's no fault! The color is completely different from what your website showed. It's a disgusting shade of green. I'm not wearing it. I'm sure the safety is fine, but I'm not sacrificing my dignity. I want a refund. Are you going to give it to me or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand completely. The color of your gear is definitely important. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, I've confirmed it. You purchased this 64 days ago, and since our standard return policy is 90 days, you are well within the window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh. Wait, really? Just like that? No hassle?

That's right. I'm sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Just attach that to the box and drop it at any shipping center.
Huh. Well... okay then. That's... better than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mark. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
